theater: 馬佐維亞與維斯瓦河下游

battle.name: 波蘭王位繼承戰爭
battle.theater: 馬佐維亞與維斯瓦河下游
battle.brief: 一七三三年二月，薩克森選侯兼波蘭王奧古斯特二世在華沙病逝，王位懸空；法國支持的前王萊什琴斯基與俄國支持的奧古斯特三世爭奪王冠，戰事自但澤打到維斯瓦河中游，聯邦議會數度被解散重開。長槍仍在波蘭立陶宛步兵中作為近戰長兵器，與火槍隊混編成方陣，守住砲隊與營壘。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 一七三三年的波蘭王位繼承戰爭，交戰方是在王位繼承的名義下重演的一場歐洲列強角力。波蘭立陶宛聯邦內部先裂成兩派：以薩克森選侯奧古斯特三世為首的一派，得到俄羅斯的出兵與帝國若干小邦的背書；以法國扶植的前王斯坦尼斯勞夫·萊什琴斯基為首的一派，握有西普魯士與大波蘭的貴族、城市市民和法國的錢械。聯邦的軍事結構是波蘭王國軍與立陶宛軍兩支常備職業軍，加上各省的民兵與農民長槍兵，總數雖可湊到十萬以上，卻分散在各省、常備不足、訓練與裝備參差。俄羅斯方面由女皇安娜與掌樞密院的大臣奧斯特爾曼主持政策，戰場上以穆尼希等將領率領俄羅斯步兵、哥薩克與加爾基里亞騎兵，並以薩克森部隊充當先鋒與攻城骨幹；薩克森自身的野戰軍不過二萬餘人，還得同時守住易北河一線。奧地利哈布斯堡王朝在名義上支持萊什琴斯基，理由是萊什琴斯基之女瑪麗亞·約瑟法已與洛林的弗朗茨·斯特凡訂婚，而奧地利真正在意的是加里西亞與聯邦的安全，於一七三五年才出兵波蘭西南部。法國是整場戰爭的策動者，以現金、軍官、顧問與小型遠征隊直接下注，目標是削弱奧地利、阻止俄奧同盟膨脹；英國與荷蘭在歐洲保持中立，卻各自暗中資助奧古斯特；瑞典一度想在波蘭北部趁火打劫，終究選擇承認奧古斯特並退出。普魯士則是沒有宣戰的第三方：腓特烈·威廉一世趁聯邦內亂揮師西普魯士，佔領但澤、托倫與格倫博，最後只把大部分城市還給波蘭，自己在西普魯士留下一枚釘子。
countriesEn: The War of the Polish Succession of 1733 was a contest between the European powers fought under the title of a succession. The Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth first split in two: a party headed by the Saxon elector Augustus III, backed by Russian troops and by the assent of several imperial states; and a party headed by the former king Stanisław Leszczyński, whom France had created, which held the nobles of Royal Prussia and Great Poland, the urban citizenry, and French money and matériel. The military structure of the Commonwealth was two professional standing armies, the Army of the Crown and the Army of Lithuania, together with the militia of each province and the peasant pikemen; the total could be raised to something over a hundred thousand, but it was scattered among the provinces, thin in permanent troops, and uneven in training and equipment. On the Russian side policy was directed by Empress Anna and by Osterman at the College of Foreign Affairs; in the field the Russian infantry, Cossacks and Kalmyk cavalry were led by commanders such as Münnich, with Saxon troops used as the spearhead and as the battering ram of assaults, while Saxony's own field army of some twenty thousand men still had to hold the Elbe line. The Habsburgs nominally supported Leszczyński, on the ground that Leszczyński's daughter Maria Josepha was already betrothed to Francis Stephen of Lorraine; what Austria really wanted was Galicia and the security of the Commonwealth, and it only sent troops into south-western Poland in 1735. France was the promoter of the whole war, staking cash, officers, advisers and small expeditionary corps directly on Leszczyński, in the hope of weakening Austria and preventing the Russian-Austrian alliance from growing. Britain and the Dutch Republic stayed neutral in Europe but each covertly financed Augustus; Sweden tried to fish in the waters of northern Poland and in the end recognised Augustus and withdrew. Prussia was the third party without a declaration of war: Frederick William I took advantage of the confusion in the Commonwealth to march into Royal Prussia and occupy Danzig, Elbląg and Grudziądz, and then returned most of the towns to Poland, keeping only a foothold for himself in Royal Prussia.
people: 這場戰爭裡推動決策的人分屬四個方向。波蘭一邊的核心是奧古斯特二世與他的兒子奧古斯特三世：老王一七三三年二月一日病逝於華沙，年僅四十歲，臨終把王位繼承的難題留給兒子；新王年方十七，幾乎全靠俄羅斯的兵與錢坐穩王位，於一七三三年四月十三日在華沙當選，一七三四年一月三十日在克拉科夫加冕。萊什琴斯基一方最不可替代的是萊什琴斯基本人與他的妻子卡塔琳娜，這位法國小提琴家的女兒後來成為路易十五的岳母；她帶著法國的現金與顧問團回到波蘭，替丈夫經營宮廷與外交，並促成女兒瑪麗亞·約瑟法與洛林的弗朗茨·斯特凡的婚事，把波蘭王冠接上了奧地利女大公瑪麗亞·特蕾莎的姻親線。俄羅斯的關鍵人物是女皇安娜、掌樞密院的大臣奧斯特爾曼與野戰統帥穆尼希；受雇於俄軍的蘇格蘭將領詹姆斯·基思以騎兵與突擊著稱，一七三三年攻入華沙的作戰中亦有他的身影。法國方面，弗雷利樞機是政策的操盤手，莫里斯·德·薩克斯以指揮官身分隨萊什琴斯基進入波蘭，維爾吉元帥在波蘭南部督戰，一七三七年再度入波的馬利元帥則打了敗仗。奧地利與普魯士各有自己的算盤：奧地利派出的是加里西亞方向與洛林方向的人馬，普魯士的腓特烈·威廉一世把這場波蘭危機看成向北擴張的機會，他要的是西普魯士的港口與腹地，而不是王冠本身。波蘭本地的關鍵人物則是各省邦聯盟的領袖與聯邦議會中的說客，真正決定王位歸屬的往往不是會戰，而是華沙、但澤與克拉科夫三座城牆的開與關。
peopleEn: The people who drove decisions in this war came from four directions. At the centre of the Polish side stood Augustus II and his son Augustus III. The old king died of illness in Warsaw on 1 February 1733 at the age of only forty, leaving the problem of the succession to his son; the new king was seventeen years old and sat on the throne almost entirely on Russian soldiers and Russian money, being elected at Warsaw on 13 April 1733 and crowned at Kraków on 30 January 1734. On the Leszczyński side the indispensable figures were Leszczyński himself and his wife Catherine, the daughter of a French violinist who later became the mother-in-law of Louis XV; she brought French money and a circle of French advisers back to Poland, ran the court and the diplomacy on her husband's behalf, and arranged the marriage of her daughter Maria Josepha to Francis Stephen of Lorraine, which tied the Polish crown by kinship to the Habsburg archduchess Maria Theresa. The key Russians were Empress Anna, Osterman at the College of Foreign Affairs and the field commander Münnich; the Scottish soldier of fortune James Keith, in Russian service, was known for cavalry work and for shock action, and he was present in the storming of Warsaw in 1733. On the French side Cardinal Fleury ran the policy, Maurice de Saxe entered Poland as a commander in Leszczyński's service, Marshal Villars directed operations in southern Poland, and Marshal Mailly invaded again in 1737 and was beaten. Austria and Prussia each had their own calculation: Austria sent contingents from the direction of Galicia and of Lorraine, while Frederick William I of Prussia saw the Polish crisis as a chance to expand northward, and wanted the harbours and the hinterland of Royal Prussia rather than the crown itself. The decisive Polish figures were the leaders of the provincial confederations and the spokesmen in the Sejm; and what in the end decided who held the crown was often not a battle but whether the walls of Warsaw, Danzig and Kraków opened or closed.
kits: 長槍在這場戰爭裡的位置，是歐洲火槍化的最後一截尾巴。俄軍、薩克森軍與普軍在一七三〇年代初都已把長槍換成火槍配刺刀：彼得大帝在一七〇〇年前後於俄國步軍中取消長槍，普魯士軍隊更早在一七〇三年就廢棄長槍改用插座刺刀，奧地利與薩克森亦在十八世紀初陸續改裝。因此本場戰爭裡真正還靠長槍作戰的是波蘭立陶宛聯邦的部隊：聯邦的省級步兵仍按傳統分成長槍兵與火槍兵兩種營，貴族自備的城鄉民兵與所謂長槍農民手持三至四公尺的直木長槍，主要任務是守住營壘、護住砲車、封鎖缺口、對抗騎兵衝鋒，在城內巷戰與攻守城中也仍是比火槍更可靠的近戰手段；火槍兵負責射擊，兩者在方陣中交替排列，長槍在前、火槍在其後。裝備層面上，聯邦步兵使用各式燧發滑膛火槍，長度與性能參差，彈藥靠城市與莊園分擔；薩克森與俄軍使用改良的燧發火槍與刺刀，刺刀旁另裝短斧；俄軍的哥薩克與聯邦的翼騎兵用長矛、馬刀與火槍，薩克森近衛騎兵更是以長矛列陣，與長槍同一血統。砲兵方面，俄薩聯軍攜帶六磅與十二磅野戰砲以及攻城重砲，攻城靠壕溝、攻城砲與地雷，並在維斯瓦河與布格河上架設浮橋；後勤靠牛車、大篷車與冬季雪橇，維斯瓦河是全軍補給的主動脈。
kitsEn: The pike occupies in this war the last stub of Europe's pike-and-shot age. The Russian, Saxon and Prussian armies had all exchanged the pike for the musket and bayonet in the early 1730s: Peter the Great had abolished the pike in Russian infantry around 1700, the Prussian army had dropped it even earlier, in 1703, for the socket bayonet, and Austria and Saxony followed through the first decades of the century. The troops that really fought with pikes in this war therefore belonged to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, whose provincial infantry still followed the old division into pikemen and musketeers; the town and country militias raised by the nobles and the so-called peasant pikemen carried straight wooden pikes three to four metres long, their tasks being to hold the camp, to guard the guns, to close breaches, to withstand cavalry charges, and in street fighting and in the attack and defence of towns they remained a more reliable close-combat arm than the musket; the musketeers shot, the two stood in the same formation with pikes in front and muskets behind. As for equipment, the Commonwealth infantry carried various flintlock smoothbores of differing length and quality, with ammunition supplied by the towns and the manors; the Saxon and Russian troops used improved flintlocks with bayonets, an axe blade fitted alongside the bayonet; the Russian Cossacks and the Commonwealth winged hussars used lances, sabres and carbines, and the Saxon guards cavalry fought in lances ranked, of the same family as the pike. On the artillery side the Russian-Saxon armies brought six- and twelve-pounder field guns together with heavy siege pieces, worked their sieges with trenches, siege guns and mines, and bridged the Vistula and the Bug with pontoons; supply moved on ox carts, covered wagons and winter sledges, and the Vistula was the artery of the whole army.
tactics: 這場戰爭的戰術樣貌與同時代的線狀戰爭略有不同：波蘭立陶宛聯邦的領土太大、城池太多，決定勝負的往往不是野戰而是圍城與行軍。一七三三年五月，萊什琴斯基在法國送來的艦隊掩護下於但澤登陸，隨即在但澤城內設立朝廷；俄薩聯軍則以攻城砲隊圍攻但澤約二十日，用水壩與浮橋封住波蘭灣，並企圖築壘破城，但守軍在將軍羅爾率領下與法國援兵、市民民兵一同抵抗，攻城最終失敗。聯軍的野戰方針是不求速決、以城市為支點：他們沿維斯瓦河與布格河推進，一七三三年九月強攻華沙，靠工兵爆破與白刃衝鋒攻下城區，萊什琴斯基於九月十二日在城內加冕。一七三四年起，聯軍把重點放在摧毀對手的野戰軍：二月六日斯托切克之戰，薩克森聯軍的先鋒被波蘭騎兵擊退；五月十八日維烏科夫、六月五日克萊茨克兩役，聯軍以步兵方陣與集中砲火擊潰以長槍兵為主力的波蘭與立陶宛聯軍，波蘭軍心隨之崩解。此後雙方的節奏變成攻佔城池與強迫投降：聯邦各省邦聯盟陸續簽下歸附奧古斯特的盟約，常備軍名存實亡。一七三六年之後法國企圖翻盤，維爾吉元帥率軍進入波蘭南部，試圖攻下克拉科夫與華沙，但俄奧兩國同時陳兵邊境，法軍不得不退；一七三七年馬利元帥再入波蘭，又被擊退。整體而言，這是一場以補給線、河流與攻城技術取勝的戰爭：維斯瓦河既是最快的運兵線，也是最難突破的天然屏障；冬季的雪橇車隊決定一次攻城的成敗；而每一場圍城都是對雙方糧秣與彈藥的消耗戰。
tacticsEn: The character of the warfare differed somewhat from the linear warfare of the same decade, because the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth had too much territory and too many towns: what usually decided the outcome was not the field battle but the siege and the march. In May 1733 Leszczyński landed at Danzig under the cover of a squadron of French ships and set up his court inside the town; the Russian-Saxon armies brought up their siege artillery against Danzig for about twenty days, dammed the Polish Bay and bridged it with pontoons, and tried to build their approaches and breach the walls, but the garrison under General Rolle, with French auxiliaries and the burgher militia, held out and the siege was abandoned. The operational doctrine of the allied army was not to seek a quick decision but to make the towns their anchors: they pushed up the Vistula and the Bug, stormed Warsaw in September 1733 with sappers, mines and the bayonet, and Leszczyński was crowned in the city on 12 September. From 1734 the allies concentrated on destroying their opponent's field army: at Stoczek on 6 February the Saxon advance was turned back by Polish cavalry; at Wiłków on 18 May and at Kletsk on 5 June the allied infantry squares and concentrated guns broke the Polish-Lithuanian army, in which the pikemen still made up the core, and the morale of the Polish side collapsed with it. The rhythm of the two sides then became the taking of towns and the forcing of capitulations: the provincial confederations of the Commonwealth one after another signed acts of submission to Augustus, and the standing armies existed on paper only. After 1736 France tried to reverse the situation; Marshal Villars led troops into southern Poland and attempted to take Kraków and Warsaw, but Russia and Austria both moved troops to their frontiers and the French withdrew; Marshal Mailly invaded Poland again in 1737 and was repulsed. In the end this was a war decided by lines of supply, by rivers and by the art of the siege: the Vistula was at once the fastest route of movement and the hardest natural barrier, the winter sledging trains decided the fate of each siege, and every investment of a town was a war of attrition upon the food and ammunition of both sides.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰爭自一七三三年二月奧古斯特二世去世起，到一七三八年十一月法奧條約生效、前線歸零為止，前後約六年；同期波蘭境內的主要會戰只有五至六場，其餘全是圍城與歸附談判。聯邦領土橫跨近一千公里，面積約四十五萬平方公里，總人口約八百萬至一千萬，其中農民佔六成以上，貴族佔少數卻握有軍職與土地，這正是常備軍小於農民兵之結構的根源。兵員上，俄軍投入的正規步兵與騎兵以萬計，薩克森出動約二萬餘人的野戰軍，聯邦兩支常備軍合計不足四萬，另有數萬農民兵可徵；一七三三年攻華沙的聯軍以數萬之眾對城內不足萬人的守軍；一七三四年五月至六月的兩場會戰，聯軍出動數萬人，波蘭與立陶宛聯軍亦在萬人上下。攻城方面，但澤一役歷時約二十日，聯軍架設浮橋與攻城砲，防守方以城牆、水壩與民兵支撐。領土變動最能說明戰局：一七三三年至一七三四年普魯士佔領西普魯士全境以及但澤、托倫、格倫博、馬爾堡等要塞，經一七三四年九月但澤條約之後除托倫等地外多數歸還波蘭，埃爾姆蘭更於一七三七年歸還；一七三六年十一月二十八日華沙條約把奧古斯特三世的繼承權與俄國在波蘭駐兵、保有羅德一帶駐地一併確認；一七三八年的安排讓奧地利取得加里西亞，法國放棄萊什琴斯基，萊什琴斯基則保有洛林與巴爾。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war ran from the death of Augustus II in February 1733 until the Franco-Austrian settlement took effect in November 1738 and the front lines went quiet, a matter of about six years; there were only five or six set-piece battles on Polish soil in that time, everything else being siege and negotiated submission. The territory of the Commonwealth stretched for close to a thousand kilometres and covered something like four hundred and fifty thousand square kilometres, with a total population of perhaps eight to ten million, more than three fifths of it peasants, and a small nobility holding the commissions and the land; that was the root of the structure in which the standing army was smaller than the peasant militia. On manpower the Russians committed regular infantry and cavalry in numbers running into the tens of thousands, Saxony fielded a field army of some twenty thousand men and more, the two standing armies of the Commonwealth together fell short of forty thousand, and several tens of thousands of peasant militia could be called up. The assault on Warsaw in 1733 was made by tens of thousands against a garrison of fewer than ten thousand, and at the two battles of May and June 1734 the allied armies numbered in the tens of thousands against a Polish-Lithuanian force of like order. On sieges, the investment of Danzig lasted about twenty days, with the allies bridging the river and bringing up siege guns while the defenders held on behind their walls, their dams and their militia. The territorial changes show the state of the war most clearly: between 1733 and 1734 Prussia occupied the whole of Royal Prussia together with fortresses such as Danzig, Elbląg, Grudziądz and Marienburg, and after the Treaty of Danzig of September 1734 most of these were returned to Poland except Elbląg and its neighbours, while Ermland was handed back in 1737; the Treaty of Warsaw of 28 November 1736 confirmed Augustus III's succession together with the Russian right to keep troops in Poland and to hold a residence around Łódź; and the settlement of 1738 gave Galicia to Austria, abandoned Leszczyński, and left Lorraine and Bar in his hands.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。最內層是聯邦本身的憲政結構：波蘭立陶宛聯邦是選舉王國，王位由全國議會推舉，新王必須簽署王位條件並受聯邦法律的束縛，而一七三二年聯邦議會決議驅逐境內的俄國與薩克森駐軍，此舉惹惱了俄國女皇安娜與薩克森選侯，兩個王朝隨即準備以武力維持對聯邦的影響。當老王一七三三年二月一日病逝，新王人選立刻被推上前台：俄羅斯需要一個聽話的、能把聯邦綁在俄奧同盟上的君主，於是推舉自己的選侯奧古斯特三世；法國則認定奧地利的聯邦盟約一旦坐實，哈布斯堡的東翼將從多瑙河一直延伸到維斯瓦河，而且波蘭一旦與薩克森合併，帝國的勢力平衡就會傾斜，於是重新扶植前王萊什琴斯基，並加上他的妻子卡塔琳娜與一整套法國式的宮廷方案。第三層是聯邦內部的黨派：萊什琴斯基獲得西部各省、但澤、托倫與城市市民的支持，並於一七三三年五月組成省邦聯盟；奧古斯特一派則握有南部大省與貴族多數。第四層是國際格局：法國要阻止俄奧同盟瓜分歐洲，奧地利要保住聯邦這道緩衝與加里西亞的期望，普魯士要趁亂把西普魯士拿到手，瑞典與土耳其都在旁邊等著削弱俄國。真正的導火線是一七三三年四月的選舉：奧古斯特三世當選，聯邦議會在華沙召開，法國隨即派兵把萊什琴斯基送到但澤，九月聯軍攻入華沙，戰爭從此全面展開。
causeEn: There were four layers of cause. The innermost was the constitutional structure of the Commonwealth itself. The Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth was an elective monarchy: the crown was chosen by the national Sejm, and a new king had to swear the conditions of the kingship and remain bound by the laws of the federation. In 1732 the Sejm resolved to expel the Russian and Saxon garrisons from Polish territory, a step that angered Empress Anna of Russia and the Saxon elector, and the two dynasties prepared to maintain their hold on the Commonwealth by force. When the old king died on 1 February 1733 the question of the new king was pushed to the front at once. Russia needed a pliant sovereign who would tie the Commonwealth to the Russian-Austrian alliance and put forward her own elector, Augustus III. France judged that if the Habsburg connection with Poland were confirmed, the eastern wing of the Habsburg lands would reach from the Danube to the Vistula, and that a union of Poland with Saxony would tilt the balance of power in the Empire; so she raised the former king Leszczyński once more, backed by his wife Catherine and by a complete French court scheme. The third layer was the party struggle inside the Commonwealth: Leszczyński won the western provinces, Danzig, Elbląg and the towns, and formed the Confederation of the Provinces in May 1733, while the Augustus party held the great southern provinces and the majority of the nobility. The fourth layer was the international alignment: France meant to prevent the Russian-Austrian partnership from dividing Europe, Austria meant to keep the Commonwealth as a buffer and to keep its claim on Galicia alive, Prussia meant to take Royal Prussia while the confusion lasted, and Sweden and Turkey waited on the side hoping Russia would be weakened. The true fuse was the election of April 1733: Augustus III was chosen, the Sejm met at Warsaw, France immediately sent troops to carry Leszczyński to Danzig, and in September the allied armies entered Warsaw, at which point the war became general.
impact: 影響可以分幾層看。第一層是波蘭立陶宛聯邦本身：這場戰爭把聯邦的憲政缺陷全部暴露並加速其崩解。省邦聯盟在屈從條件下簽下盟約，王權被架空，常備軍被解散，議會被俄國與薩克森的小團體控制，這套所謂的自由到一七三〇年代中期實際上只剩下被外國干預的管道，為一七七二年第一次瓜分鋪好路。萊什琴斯基一方則留下一份制度遺產：一七三七年經托倫省邦聯盟批准的善政憲章，以三院議會、常設委員會、國家預算、常備軍上限、宗教寬容與以成文法限制貴族司法特權等條款論，一度被視為歐洲第一部成文憲法，讓這場戰爭在思想史上也留有一席。第二層是歐洲權力平衡：法國第一次試圖在東歐扶植一個可以制約奧地利的王國而失敗，俄奧同盟反而鞏固；一七三八年後奧地利取得加里西亞，洛林問題卻仍懸而未決，同年《凡爾賽條約》把洛林交給洛林的弗朗茨·斯特凡，兩年後他成為奧地利女大公瑪麗亞·特蕾莎的丈夫，波蘭王位戰爭與七年後的奧地利王位繼承戰爭之間，就這樣拉起一條直接的因果線。第三層是軍備與戰術：這是歐洲大陸上最後幾場仍看得到長槍實戰的戰爭之一，波蘭與立陶宛的省級步兵仍以長槍兵與火槍兵混編作戰，而俄軍、普軍與薩克森軍早已改用火槍配刺刀，戰後歐洲步兵的長槍全面退場，只在儀仗與老兵的記憶中留下位置。第四層是東南歐：波蘭需要奧地利與土耳其制衡俄國，奧土同盟因此成立，一七三五年至一七三九年的波蘭-土耳其戰爭與俄土戰爭相連，導致一七三九年貝爾格萊德條約，也把俄國的南進壓力轉移到克里米亞與黑海，之後才是一七六八年至一七七四年的俄土戰爭。第五層是普魯士與但澤：普魯士在西普魯士取得的港口與通行權，使它在一七七二年瓜分中獲得埃爾姆蘭，一七九三年第二次瓜分時得到但澤、托倫與皇家普魯士，最終成為波蘭西界爭議的源頭。
impactEn: The effects can be read on several levels. The first is the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth itself, for this war exposed every constitutional weakness of the federation and hurried its dissolution. The provincial confederations signed their acts of submission on humiliating terms, royal authority was hollowed out, the standing armies were dispersed, and the Sejm passed into the hands of a small group of Russian and Saxon hands; by the middle of the 1730s what was called the Golden Liberty was in practice only a channel for foreign intervention, and the road to the first partition of 1772 was prepared. The Leszczyński side left behind an institutional legacy: the Constitution of the Good Government, approved by the Confederation of Toruń in 1737, with its three-chamber Sejm, its permanent commission, its state budget, its ceiling on the size of the standing army, its religious toleration and its restriction by written law of the judicial privileges of the nobility, was for a time regarded as the first written constitution in Europe, and gave the war a place in the history of ideas as well. The second level is the European balance of power. France's first attempt to raise a dependent monarchy in eastern Europe to hold Austria in check failed, and the Russian-Austrian partnership was consolidated instead; after 1738 Austria had gained Galicia, but the question of Lorraine remained open, and the Treaty of Versailles of the same year handed Lorraine to Francis Stephen of Lorraine, who two years later became the husband of the Austrian archduchess Maria Theresa. Between the Polish war of the succession and the Austrian war of the succession seven years later a direct line of cause and effect thus runs. The third level is armament and tactics: this was one of the last wars on the European continent in which the pike was still fought with in earnest, the provincial infantry of Poland and Lithuania still marching in mixed formations of pikemen and musketeers, while the Russian, Prussian and Saxon armies had long gone over to musket and bayonet; after it the pike left European infantry altogether and survived only in ceremony and in the memory of old soldiers. The fourth level is south-eastern Europe. Poland needed Austria and Turkey to hold Russia in check, and the Austro-Turkish alliance was the result; the Polish-Turkish war of 1735 to 1739 ran alongside the Russo-Turkish war and led to the Treaty of Belgrade of 1739, and it was that war which turned Russia's pressure south towards the Crimea and the Black Sea, and so towards the Russo-Turkish wars of 1768 to 1774. The fifth level is Prussia and Danzig. The harbours and the right of passage Prussia acquired in Royal Prussia gave it Ermland in the partition of 1772, and Danzig, Elbląg and Royal Prussia in the partition of 1793, and those claims remained at the root of every later dispute over Poland's western frontier.
result: 一七三三年至一七三八年的收場是一連串讓步：一七三四年一月奧古斯特三世在克拉科夫加冕，聯邦的王冠實際上落在俄薩聯軍的監視之下；萊什琴斯基退守西部，於一七三五年九月十二日在華沙加冕，成為歐洲所承認的波蘭王，但他的國家已由聯軍瓜分；一七三六年十一月二十八日華沙條約把奧古斯特三世的繼承權寫成定案，同時確認俄國有權在波蘭駐兵並保有羅德一帶的沙皇駐地，波蘭軍隊被縮減到俄國可以容忍的規模；一七三七年法軍再度失敗，維爾吉與馬利兩次入波皆無功而返，俄奧兩國在邊境對峙，幾乎開火；一七三八年《維也納條約》與《凡爾賽條約》把這一切定案：奧地利取得加里西亞，萊什琴斯基放棄波蘭王冠而保有洛林與巴爾，並以托斯卡納及其港口里弗諾作為安置，俄國保住對王位的發言權，薩克森保住王位也保住了聯邦的空洞，聯邦議會在此期間數度被解散重開，重新開會時已無人再提金色自由。至於長槍：這場戰爭是它在歐洲大陸上最後的實戰歲月，波蘭聯邦的長槍兵在斯托切克、維烏科夫與克萊茨克三次戰役中仍上陣，但每一次敗陣之後，長槍的時代也就更接近終點，幾年之後連最後保留長槍的歐洲軍隊也換上了刺刀。
resultEn: The outcome of 1733 to 1738 was a series of concessions. In January 1734 Augustus III was crowned at Kraków, and the crown of the Commonwealth in practice sat under the watch of the Russian and Saxon armies. Leszczyński fell back to the west and was crowned at Warsaw on 12 September 1735 as the king of Poland recognised in Europe, but his country had already been divided among the allies. The Treaty of Warsaw of 28 November 1736 wrote down Augustus III's succession as settled, confirmed the right of Russia to keep troops in Poland and to hold a residence around Łódź, and reduced the Polish army to a size Russia could tolerate. In 1737 the French failed once more, Villars and Mailly both entering Poland to no effect, while Russia and Austria faced one another on their frontiers and came close to firing. The Treaties of Vienna and Versailles in 1738 settled everything: Austria received Galicia, Leszczyński gave up the Polish crown but kept Lorraine and Bar and was provided for with Tuscany and its port of Livorno, Russia kept its say in the crown, Saxony kept the crown together with the hollow shell of the Commonwealth, and the Sejm was dissolved and reconvened several times in these years without anyone raising the Golden Freedom again. As for the pike: this war was its last season of real fighting on the European continent. The pikemen of the Polish Commonwealth still went into action at Stoczek, at Wiłków and at Kletsk, but each defeat carried the pike a little nearer to its end, and within a few years even the last European army that kept it had taken to the bayonet.
